scope: read-only target selection for KIDS_RESOURCE artifact binding
query: SELECT dataset_snapshot_id,dataset_version_id,status,created_at FROM publication.dataset_snapshot WHERE dataset_version_id=73 ORDER BY dataset_snapshot_id DESC
environment: remote dev Data Plane geostat-data; production untouched
bindingPolicy: ArtifactAttachmentService only binds snapshots in REVIEW_REQUIRED or SEMANTIC_REVIEW; it must not mutate PUBLISHED snapshots.
requiredNextStep: Create a new KIDS_RESOURCE Data Plane snapshot through the governed ingestion/review workflow; do not update snapshot rows directly.
